summary: Live-vector personalization and ranking infrastructure for commerce teams.
editor_note: Real-time behavioral vectors are a sharper commerce primitive than another campaign dashboard. Every search, hover, scroll, and cart action can update ranking immediately, and the official technology page reports a 14-day time to value. Unlike history-only recommenders, the system is designed around a shopper's changing intent. The open question is whether early enterprise gains repeat across smaller catalogs without heavy tuning.

product_evidence.claim: Malachyte converts each search, hover, scroll, and add-to-cart event into a live shopper vector and uses a visual transformer to rank products against current intent.
The official product surface describes a plug-and-play API and live attribution, while its Shopify article says the system layers onto an existing Shopify stack without re-platforming.

market_context.primary_user: Commerce and merchandising teams that need onsite ranking to respond to a shopper's current session rather than only historical segments.
market_context.differentiation: Live behavioral vectors and visual-product ranking update recommendations during the session while keeping the data first-party and non-PII.
market_context.why_now: The August 2026 Seed follows the product's Shopify general availability and gives a newly visible system capital to expand beyond its initial enterprise cohort.

risks.claim: Whether the reported lift repeats across smaller merchants and sparse catalogs without material manual tuning can be tested through cohort-level Shopify case studies.
risks.basis: The official implementation promise is short, but current public evidence is concentrated in an early enterprise customer set.
